column1: # Functions PostgREST publishes that nothing in this repository calls.
# Reachable over HTTP and by nothing else: no RPC call site, no trigger, no policy, no view,
# no cron entry, no other function. Each is an endpoint whose only caller would be a client
# Recorded rather than dropped: an entry here is a candidate for removal, not a defect. A
# function reached only by a service-role client outside this repository is legitimate.
# scripts/check-published-no-caller.sh fails when the set changes, so a NEW one is a reviewed
